analyst.summary: GNFC is a debt-free Gujarat-government-backed chemicals and fertilizer manufacturer trading below book value with a real dividend yield, currently working through a commodity chemicals down-cycle that has pushed reported revenue growth negative. A meaningful part of recent profit comes from other income/treasury income rather than the core chemicals business, so headline earnings should be read with some caution, but the balance-sheet safety net (no debt, sub-book valuation, consistent dividend) is real. We move this from a quant Sell to a Hold given that safety cushion.
